historical_record.description: An existing three-story commercial building stood at the site.
The City Planning Commission approved installing 3 panel antennas on the roof of an existing 3-story commercial building and base station equipment in the basement, 7-0.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to install a wireless telecommunications facility for Cingular Wireless, consisting of three antennas and three equipment cabinets, on the existing three-story office building at 990 Columbus Avenue.
